en: Envelop a burst of laughter

en: One sound fills the entire sky

pinyin: he qiu long
en: And the prison

hanzi: 那是不是你渴望的自由
pinyin: na shi bu shi ni ke wang de zi you
en: Is that the freedom you long for?
